mission_08: Outstanding! You have successfully used PCA for noise reduction. You learned how to determine the optimal number of components using cumulative explained variance, project data onto these components, and reconstruct denoised data through inverse transformation. The MSE comparison shows how PCA filtering reduces noise while preserving the underlying signal structure. This denoising technique is widely used in image processing, signal processing, and any domain where data contains both meaningful patterns and random noise. PCA denoising works because noise is typically distributed across all dimensions while signal concentrates in fewer directions.
